existing_derivations.title: The Maximum Mass of Ideal White Dwarfs
existing_derivations.abstract: The Chandrasekhar limit ~1.4 M☉ is derived from balancing electron degeneracy pressure against gravitational collapse, using relativistic quantum mechanics.

z_squared_connection: No clear Z² connection found in literature
physical_meaning: Maximum mass of a stable white dwarf star
mathematical_path: Start from fundamental laws (QFT/GR). Identify relevant Lagrangian. Use perturbation theory or exact solutions. Extract dimensionless ratio.
